meta.title: A line-level RFP should not close until every vendor on every line is scored
gaps: No setup recipe creates an RFP with two lines, two vendors, and responses from both vendors.
No operation or library case scores an evaluator's form for a vendor on a line.
No available token identifies the required evaluation forms or the second vendor's evaluation data.
The requested round-closing and evaluation-window assertions are not expressible with the available read-back fields.
